summary: Reproduced at 1d77c0525ab2. Loading a Phi3 model with fused qkv_proj.weight and per-projection biases at {q,k,v}_proj.bias: q's loaded bias equalled its own (frange [0, 256)), but k's and v's loaded biases were empty (shape [0]) because the 256-element per-projection bias was sliced with the fused bounds [256, 512) and [512, 768); the forward pass then raised RuntimeError. Attempt 001 placed the bias under the fused key and is inconclusive.
what_ran: repro.py writes a tiny random 1-layer Phi3ForCausalLM (fused qkv_proj and gate_up_proj weights, q/k/v biases at their own keys), loads it unquantized with Config.from_directory / Model.from_config / model.load on physical GPU 1, inspects each projection's loaded bias, and runs one forward pass. Environment py311-81fd62ef04f7-torch26cu126.
limits: Unquantized load; one padding case (no output padding needed at H=256, so the 'lose padding' variant was not exercised).
